# Footer — Implementation Checklist

## 1. Structure

* [ ] Refactor `footer.html` into three logical areas:

  * FFG identity
  * external/social links
  * legal/institutional links
* [ ] Keep the footer semantically simple: `<footer>`, navigation groups where appropriate, copyright.
* [ ] Do **not** duplicate header navigation.
* [ ] Do **not** add Contact, Projects, Journal, About, etc.

## 2. Brand block

* [ ] Keep `Flying Fortress Games`.
* [ ] Keep the tagline:
  `Elegance in design. Engineering in every detail.`
* [ ] Keep the copyright year generated by Hugo.
* [ ] Establish clear hierarchy between brand, tagline and utility content.

## 3. External links

* [ ] Add GitHub.
* [ ] Add YouTube.
* [ ] Add RSS.
* [ ] Reuse the existing SVG partials.
* [ ] Ensure SVGs inherit colour through `currentColor`.
* [ ] Give icon-only links accessible labels.
* [ ] Decide whether external destinations open in the same tab; apply consistently.

## 4. Institutional / legal links

* [ ] Add Privacy.
* [ ] Add Publishing & Social Media when its page exists.
* [ ] Add Licensing when its page exists.

## 5. Visual design

* [ ] Use the existing design tokens only; avoid footer-specific raw colours unless genuinely necessary.
* [ ] Establish a deliberate boundary between page content and footer.
* [ ] Keep brass as an accent rather than a dominant surface.
* [ ] Keep ornamentation restrained.
* [ ] Make the footer feel like a closing signature, not another navigation bar.
* [ ] Avoid reproducing the header treatment.

## 6. Layout

* [ ] Desktop: establish a compact horizontal composition.
* [ ] Mobile: collapse cleanly without tiny links or awkward wrapping.
* [ ] Preserve the global `site-frame` alignment.
* [ ] Check spacing against pages of very different heights.
* [ ] Ensure the footer does not visually compete with full-screen project artwork.

## 7. Interaction & accessibility

* [ ] Provide visible hover states.
* [ ] Provide visible keyboard focus states.
* [ ] Verify useful tap targets on mobile.
* [ ] Verify contrast for text, icons and links.
* [ ] Verify link labels make sense to screen readers.

## 8. Integration

* [ ] Verify footer on Home.
* [ ] Verify footer on Projects.
* [ ] Verify footer on Journal/article pages.
* [ ] Verify footer on ordinary content pages.
* [ ] Verify footer on 404.
* [ ] Check desktop, tablet and mobile widths.
* [ ] Run Hugo build with no warnings/errors.

## 9. Finish

* [ ] Remove obsolete footer CSS.
* [ ] Remove unused markup/classes.
* [ ] Confirm no duplicated header functionality remains.
* [ ] Update this checklist.
* [ ] Add a REX only if the implementation produces decisions or lessons worth preserving.
